overview: Self-hosted workspace for designing prototypes, assets, and agent-driven creative projects with your team.
description:
OpenDesign is an open-source collaborative AI design workspace for creating prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with a team and coding agents. It combines a browser-based workspace with reusable design systems, templates, plugins, and agent integrations.

This Websoft9 package deploys the official `ghcr.io/nexu-io/od` image as a single container, following the upstream Docker deployment pattern. The package preserves persistent state in the `opendesign_data` volume mounted at `/app/.od` and enables the upstream health endpoint at `/api/health` for readiness checks.

Typical use cases include self-hosted AI design studios, collaborative prototyping teams, internal creative workspaces, and organizations that want to run OpenDesign with their own infrastructure and model credentials.
